description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that contains and manages a custom LogView for displaying log data within an Android application. It provides UI setup, view inflation, and basic interaction logic.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages a TextView-based logging interface, suitable for displaying log messages within the app.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView instances, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the views, sets a TextWatcher to scroll the log view to the bottom after text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor for retrieving the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
